exposure: Gualou Xiaoyong Decoction combined with painless lactation manipulation
cohort: 41 patients with lactational acute mastitis and breast abscess treated between October 2021 and October 2022
finding: Gualou Xiaoyong Decoction combined with painless lactation manipulation was effective in treating lactational acute mastitis and breast abscess, leading to improvements in clinical symptoms, inflammatory markers, and bacterial clearance.
